name: Machine Chest Press
summary: A seated machine exercise that builds upper-body pressing strength by targeting the chest, shoulders, and triceps along a guided path.

setup: Adjust the seat height so the machine handles sit level with your mid-to-lower chest.
Sit upright with your back and head pressed firmly against the back pad and feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and set your shoulder blades back and down into the pad.
steps: Press the handles away from your chest smoothly until your arms are extended without aggressively locking the elbows.
Pause briefly at full extension while keeping tension on your pectoral muscles.
Lower the handles under control along the machine track until you feel a comfortable stretch across your chest.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press the handles forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
cues: Pin your shoulder blades to the pad.
Control the descent; don't bounce off the bottom.

common_faults.fault: Seat height set too low, forcing the shoulders to press too high above mid-chest level.
common_faults.correction: Adjust the seat so the handles align directly across your mid-to-lower pectorals.

common_faults.fault: Shoulders rolling forward off the back pad at full extension.
common_faults.correction: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed against the pad throughout the entire movement.

precautions: Avoid letting your elbows flare excessively past a 90-degree angle from your torso to protect the shoulder joint.
